# Hernández-Huertas L, Moreno-Sánchez I, Crespo-Cuadrado J, et al. 2025. CRISPR-RfxCas13d screening uncovers Bckdk as a post-translational regulator of maternal-to-zygotic transition in teleosts. EMBO J 44:7021-7059. https://doi.org/10.1038/s44318-025-00617-8

# Cutoff: the paper calls a knockdown positive when more than 35% of embryos show developmental delay (30-50% epiboly at 6 hpf); 7 of 49 positive (call column); all 49 screened genes listed (gfp, rfp and nanog controls left out); score = mean over the published replicates of the percentages at 30% plus 50% epiboly (Fig1C sheet); the paper also reports a 24 hpf phenotype for mibp (Fig EV1E), not flagged here
